name: Valle
notes: Michelin-starred tasting-menu restaurant (chef Roberto Alcocer). Only whole-experience prices are published: Sample Tasting Menu $220++, Breve Experience (El Sillon bar experience) $140++, plus wine-pairing add-ons ($40-$230). The a-la-carte 'Bar Menu' (Bean Bread, Sikil Pak, Ceviche Verde Tostada, Burrito, THE Cheeseburger, Quesataco, Birria, Pescado, etc.) and the Cocktails menu list dish/drink names with zero per-item prices anywhere: checked the site's own JSON-LD (six Menu blocks, every item's offers empty/absent), the rendered HTML (no price elements at all beyond the tasting-package copy), and the SinglePlatform mirror (places.singleplatform.com/valle/menu), which lists the same items with price:"" on every single Offer. No PDF menu, no ordering platform found. This is the 'fine-dining room that prices only the caviar' case from the playbook - per-item prices are never published anywhere, so not_found rather than blocked.

blocked: No website; every reachable source is either priceless or needs a browser. zmenu.com's menu page (an actual named menu URL, apparently once holding priced items like tacos/tostadas/burritos) is behind a Cloudflare interactive challenge that defeats curl, WebFetch, and the r.jina.ai proxy alike (403 / 'Just a moment...'). No SinglePlatform listing found for this business.
notes: Address on the work list ('17089 Can...') is truncated; the only Dulzura Mini Market found is at 17023 Campo Rd / Hwy 94, Dulzura, CA 91917 (population ~100 unincorporated town, essentially one business of this name/type) - treated as the same restaurant. A Chrome-equipped agent should try zmenu.com's Cloudflare challenge and Yelp's dated photo gallery first.

name: Tabu Shabu
notes: First-party site, server-rendered HTML (Next.js) with explicit name/desc/price spans for every item. Shabu-shabu (hot pot) format: Step 4 proteins and the 2-item combos are priced by portion size (4oz reg / 6oz lg / 8oz dbl / 3oz side) - recorded price is the reg/first listed tier, full tier breakdown kept in description per item. Broth and noodle upgrades (Sukiyaki, Tonkotsu, Ramen noodle, Kale ramen noodle) are priced as upcharges over an included default (traditional kombu broth / rice or udon or shirataki noodle, all free) - recorded at their upcharge amount with that noted in description. Wine (Justin sauvignon blanc, Mondavi cabernet) recorded at the glass price, bottle price noted in description. Dropped as unpriced/no real price: included default broth (Traditional kombu, Miso), included default starches (rice, udon, shirataki), free items (Save your noodles finish, Hot tea), and Craft beer ("see our rotating tap & bottle board", genuinely unpriced/variable). Categories reached: FIVE SIMPLE STEPS (hot-pot build: broth, rice/noodle, included veggies, standard proteins, premium proteins, finish), SNACKS & STARTERS (starters, extras & garnishes), DRINKS & DESSERT (sake, beer & wine, zero-proof, dessert). Nothing else on the site (only Home/Menu links present) so no categories were missed.

notes: No independent restaurant-owned website (fruitylocogo.twupro.com, found via search, is a generic AI-template marketing page - literal placeholder menu items 'Chef Special / Daily pick', 'Fresh Salad / Crisp Popular', 'House Soup / Homemade Classic' with no real names or prices - discarded as unusable, not a real source). Prices pulled from order.online (DoorDash white-label storefront, the restaurant's own ordering page), reading the escaped Next.js RSC flight payload (MenuBookCategory list + per-category MenuPageItemList/MenuPageItem objects with displayPrice), not the virtualized DOM grid which renders empty. Captured all 18 real categories; item counts per category matched the platform's own declared numItems exactly (e.g. Tortas 7/7, Juices 6/6), so this is the complete menu, not a sample. No independent priced first-party or dine-in source was available to fully clear the markup question, hence medium rather than high confidence. Fruit Salad and Fruit Cocktail are priced '5.49+' (has size/add-on options) - recorded at the base price with that noted in description.
